content.rendered:
Middleton has partnered with Sherwood 4Kids Sake and the Sherwood Elks club to bring gifts to our local Sherwood families in need.  We have 100 tags ready for pick-up.  If you would like to participate you can sign out a tag in front of our school 30 minutes before the start of school and 30 minutes after school.  If you are unable to make it at these times, you can come into the office during the day to check out a tag.  An adult must be present to receive a tag.  Each Sherwood 4Kids Sake (S4KS) tag will list an individual’s need with specific gift choices.  You are also welcome to bring in an unwrapped toy, coat, and pajamas for the Sherwood Elks Club to distribute over the holiday season. 

All donations need to be brought back to Middleton no later than December 8th.  We will have a bin located inside the front lobby for drop off.   S4KS tags need to be firmly attached to the package when returned and all gifts for both S4ks and The Sherwood Elks club need to be returned unwrapped.

To learn more about Sherwood 4 Kids Sake or make a monetary donation click HERE.  If you have any questions you can reach out to our Toy Drive Coordinator, Melissa Horton at gmpschorton@gmail.com.

Thank you in advance for helping us make every kid’s holiday a great one!
